title: Adding SSL Certificates for NSS Servers

blocks.text: Before reading this article, see the Nanolog Streaming Service (NSS) deployment guide for your platform:

blocks.item: NSS Deployment Guide for Amazon Web Services
NSS Deployment Guide for Google Cloud Platform
NSS Deployment Guide for Microsoft Azure
NSS Deployment Guide for VMware vSphere
From the navigation menu, go to Data Explorer > Log Streaming > Internet Log Streaming - Nanolog Streaming Service.
From the NSS Servers tab, click the New Client Certificate icon for the NSS server.
In the New Client Certificate window:
Download Config (Optional): Download the configuration script for the new certificate.
Upload Provisioning Blob: Select to either enter the blob data in the text field, or to upload the blob file. If you select Upload Blob File, click Choose File, and select a file from your device.
Click View Details to view a dropdown of the certificate information.
